patronOf.pt-BR: Padroeira da juventude e da pureza

prayerExcerpt.en-US: O God, author of innocence and lover of chastity
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Ó Deus, fonte da inocência e alegria dos puros de coração

meta.face: A girl of eleven, visibly a child, with a round, soft face, a lightly sun-warmed complexion, long, wavy chestnut-brown hair parted in the middle and loosely tied back, large dark-brown eyes and a serene, trusting gaze; no crown, no veil.
meta.basis: The only photograph of her (1902, among the farm's poultry in a white blouse and apron) and the traditional portrait with long wavy chestnut hair; Wikipedia gives her attributes as lily, farmer's clothing and palm. She died at eleven.
